feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 9 October 2026 10:22pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Friday, 09 October 2026 at 10:15pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds.


##Synopsis##

Complex low from Iceland to Scandinavia. Ridges of high pressure from the Azores to France and towards Greenland.


##Wind##

West or west-northwest 6 or 7, decreasing 5 or 6 tomorrow afternoon, veering northwest in the evening.


##State of Sea##

Mainly moderate, but occasionally rough in the east of the area tonight and tomorrow morning.


##Weather##

Isolated showers.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in showers.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Northwest 5 or 6, gradually decreasing west-northwest or west 3 or 4 overnight into Sunday, backing southwest or south 2 to 4 Sunday morning, then southeast 5 or 6 during the evening.


##State of Sea##

Moderate, imminently falling slight, then smooth or slight on Sunday, building slight or moderate in the evening.


##Weather##

Isolated showers at first, becoming fair. Rain spreading from the southwest Sunday evening.


##Visibility##

Mostly good, occasionally moderate in the rain later.
